slides.headline: 6 PROMPTS YOUR $300/HOUR ADVISOR BILLS YOU FOR THAT AI DOES FREE
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei, gold pinstripe blazer, chest-up, smiling, thrusting financial report with red stamp toward camera; coins and $ on amber desk; Claude logo on gold wall. Documentary 35mm, natural texture, gold-red scheme.

slides.headline: 1) FIND WHERE YOUR MONEY IS QUIETLY DISAPPEARING
slides.body: Millionaires track every dollar. You're probably wasting $47 a month on forgotten subscriptions alone. "Here are my monthly expenses: [paste list]. Find every charge I don't need. Be brutal."

slides.headline: 2) BUILD YOUR 10-YEAR PATH TO $1 MILLION
slides.body: Millionaires have a written plan. Most people don't. This prompt builds yours in 3 minutes. "I have [savings] saved, earn [income] a year. Build my 10-year path to $1M. Be specific."

slides.headline: 3) ANALYZE ANY INVESTMENT BEFORE YOU COMMIT
slides.body: Millionaires never commit money without vetting it. Financial advisors charge $300 an hour to do this. "I'm considering this investment: [describe it]. What am I missing? Worst case? Be direct."

slides.headline: 4) FIND THE SIDE INCOME HIDING IN YOUR SKILLS
slides.body:
Millionaires have multiple income streams. You probably have the raw material for at least one more.

"Here are my skills: [list]. What's the fastest side income I can start this week? Be specific."

slides.headline: 5) GET MORE MONEY IN YOUR NEXT NEGOTIATION
slides.body:
Millionaires never accept the first number. This gives you the exact words to negotiate more.

"I'm negotiating [raise or rate]. My current [amount]. Write exactly what I should say to get more."

slides.headline: 6) RECESSION-PROOF YOUR MONEY STARTING TONIGHT
slides.body: Fidelity's 595,000 millionaires protected their base before they grew it. Here's how. "My financial situation: [describe]. How do I protect what I have if the economy turns? Be specific."

caption:
